SQL:
SELECT
  regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
  COUNT(*) AS "customers.customers"
FROM customers AS customers
LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
  ON customers.region_id = regions.id
WHERE
  CASE
    WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR ['vip', 'partner'] IS NULL
    THEN NULL
    ELSE LIST_HAS_ANY(
      [__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL],
      [__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN ['vip', 'partner'] IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL]
    )
  END
GROUP BY
  regions.name
ORDER BY
  "customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21
